Subject: Renewal outlook & ask for 2027 term

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Attached is a quick snapshot of our projected usage for H2 (Nebula_Renewal_Details.xlsx). We want to lock pricing for 12 months but are asking for a modest discount tier if we commit to a 25% uplift in reserve capacity.

High level:
- Current commit: 40k token-minutes/month
- Target commit if we upgrade: 50k token-minutes/month (25% uplift)
- Priority asks: 12-month price hold, accelerated burst capacity for Q4, and a minor SLA improvement for P99 latency from 350ms -> 300ms for production routes.

Can you share a proposed term sheet and whether Redwood can offer a short protection credit in case of under-utilization in the first quarter? Evan (cc) is handling procurement.

Thanks,

CTO, NebulaWorks

Subject: Re: Renewal outlook & ask for 2027 term

Hi Maya — really appreciate the detail. We can move quickly on this. Draft proposal attached (Proposed_Term_Sheet.pdf) with three levers I think will work for both sides:

1) 12-month price hold at the current blended rate if Nebula commits to the 25% uplift in reserved capacity.
2) A one-quarter under-utilization protection credit equal to up to 10% of committed spend if usage remains below 80% of the committed baseline in Q1.
3) A conditional P99 improvement to 300ms for the production routes you specify, backed by a response-time SLA and a short operational runbook (we'll include tracing hooks).

Numbers summary (headline):
- Committed baseline: 50k token-minutes/month (12 months)
- Effective discount schedule: 7% immediate volume discount + up to 3% performance rebate tied to latency SLA attainment (quarterly measurement)
- Burst pool: additional on-demand burst capacity with a pre-agreed cap and a 20% premium over the committed unit rate.

Next steps: if this matches what you had in mind, we'll circulate an outbound DocuSign and queue SRE to confirm the runbook. We can also build a small credit bucket for Q1 under-utilization — propose the credit be applied to month 4 invoice to simplify billing.

Do you want us to slot a 30-minute call Wednesday 10am PT to run through the term sheet?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Ben/Laura — forwarding the ask from Nebula. Quick internal note on negotiation posture and margin impact so we can sign off before the call: 

Context:
- Customer is strategic (product integrations live in two key accounts). Upsell to 50k is reasonable and low churn risk.
- They want price hold + small SLA uplift; asking for under-utilization credit is normal.

Proposal highlights (what I sent):
- 7% up-front volume discount (applies immediately once new commit: 50k)
- Up to 3% rebate tied to P99 latency (measured quarterly)
- Q1 under-util protection credit up to 10% of committed spend, applied to invoice in month 4
- Burst pool charges at +20% unit rate, capped by pre-agreed burst cap

Impacts:
- Expected blended rev: +18% ARR if commit realized
- Worst-case (they don't hit uplift but still keep baseline): revenue flat, credit hit capped at 10% for Q1 only

Ask: Ben — do we sign off on the 7% discount + 3% latency rebate and the 10% Q1 protection? If yes, I'll put the term sheet in DocuSign and loop SRE/product for the runbook.

If no, alternatives: reduce immediate discount to 5% and move the 3% rebate to discretionary ops credits (not cash).

Thanks,
Olga
